answer: Rotation is entered in the yarrow index and the onyx audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 118 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the vertex beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
